channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Furkan Korkmaz | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Furkan Korkmaz from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Furkan Korkmaz
item.description:
“Plays the game the right way. When you have a player like that who plays the game the right way, is very unselfish, it makes it easier for everybody else around him. Me, him, and (Furkan) Korkmaz are out there together — very high IQ basketball players who know how to play the game the right way. It’s been fun and you can see it throughout the box score with our plus-minus.”

Patrick Beverley on Furkan Korkmaz, Nov 7, 2023. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Furkan Korkmaz
item.description:
Morey, on Korkmaz (continued):

“At shootaround today a big theme was guys like Furkan, they're gonna get a shot this year and we're gonna need them to step up. We expect he will. He's got a great attitude and approach.”

Daryl Morey on Furkan Korkmaz, Feb 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @DerekBodnerNBA.

item.title: Paul Reed on Furkan Korkmaz
item.description:
Rich Hoffman:Paul Reed on Furkan Korkmaz’s shooting:

“I was like, ‘This guy is insane. Hopefully I can get on his level one day.’”

Paul Reed on Furkan Korkmaz, Nov 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @rich_hofmann.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Furkan Korkmaz
item.description:
Ky Carlin:Daryl Morey on Korkmaz returning:

“We’re thrilled that Furkan is returning to the 76ers. His work ethic and commitment have helped him evolve into a high-level rotation player in the NBA.He’s proven to be a dangerous three-point threat and he continues to make great strides as a defender thanks to his length and size. We’re excited for Furkan’s future here.”

Daryl Morey on Furkan Korkmaz, Aug 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @Ky_Carlin.

item.title: Enes Kanter Freedom on Furkan Korkmaz
item.description:
“Especially Ersan, I played with him in OKC. I played with him on the national team. Cedi and Furkan played with my brother (Kerem Kanter) on the national team. No answer. That’s the thing that hurts me the most. They’re just scared. They don’t know any better,”

Enes Kanter Freedom on Furkan Korkmaz, Jul 18, 2020. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Brett Brown on Furkan Korkmaz
item.description:
Serena Winters:Brett Brown on Furkan Korkmaz’ growth:

“If the playoffs started tomorrow, he would be in our rotation in a significant way,and if you told him that or me that in June of last year, we probably both would’ve been surprised.”

Brett Brown on Furkan Korkmaz, Mar 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: Brett Brown on Furkan Korkmaz
item.description:
Serena Winters:Brett Brown:

“Furkan’s confidence is at an all-time high and it should be, but his defense is the thing I’m most happy with.”

Brett Brown on Furkan Korkmaz, Nov 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: Elton Brand on Furkan Korkmaz
item.description:
“We’re excited to have Furkan back and look forward to his continued growth and contributions,”

Elton Brand on Furkan Korkmaz, Jul 25, 2019. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Furkan Korkmaz
item.description:
“Furkan is another talented young player that we are excited to have in our program.”

Bryan Colangelo on Furkan Korkmaz, Jul 4, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Furkan Korkmaz
item.description:
“We are happy to have Furkan Korkmaz join us in Philadelphia this year where we feel he will be best positioned to develop physically and acclimate to the NBA game,”

Bryan Colangelo on Furkan Korkmaz, Jul 4, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Furkan Korkmaz
item.description:
“I think [Korkmaz] might actually be better off in a situation where he comes over sooner rather than later, because he can be exposed to different things and possibly develop.”

Bryan Colangelo on Furkan Korkmaz, Jun 25, 2016. Source: Philadelphia Magazine.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Furkan Korkmaz
item.description:
Colangelo, however, said there could be benefits to bringing them both over now.

“You could make an argument that he’s [Korkmaz] better off staying one or two more seasons in Europe and developing, but we’re a young team,”

Bryan Colangelo on Furkan Korkmaz, Jun 25, 2016. Source: Philadelphia Magazine.
